name: stem_dpo_benchmark_2
description: STEM DPO Benchmark 2 is a collection of STEM-oriented problems intended to evaluate model performance on scientific and mathematical reasoning tasks. It is organized to support evaluation of models and preference-optimization workflows (e.g., direct preference optimization) on STEM questions. The benchmark includes questions requiring domain knowledge and stepwise reasoning across STEM topics.
reputation: Relatively small / recent dataset on HuggingFace with limited community adoption so far.
